name: ltv-logo-monorepo
description: LTV animated logo for vanilla JS/TS, Vue and React

scripts.build: bun run --filter 'ltv-logo-js' build && bun run --filter 'ltv-logo-vue' --filter 'ltv-logo-react' build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.playground: bun run --filter ltv-logo-js build && bun scripts/playground.ts
